visible_evidence: Morgan first stares at Riley without contributing.

description: Five Minecraft players repair a bridge. Chat is disabled. The visible incident escalates from staring to gesture, invasion of space, and object damage within one scenario.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places three stone slabs on Riley's bridge side, adds one fence rail, and steps to the side to inspect the bridge.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan stops building and faces Riley for several seconds. Morgan then crouches repeatedly twice and swings an empty hand toward Riley's fence rail. Riley steps two blocks away to the side of the bridge. Morgan follows into the same side space and stands one block from Riley. Morgan then breaks two stone slabs Riley placed, breaks Riley's fence rail, and stands on the gap left in Riley's bridge side.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey steps onto the gap Morgan is standing in, shoulder-to-shoulder, places two stone slabs to repair Riley’s broken tiles beneath, then places a fence rail along the centerline and stands on it to hold the lane open.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves along the observer line to the shared chest, takes two stone slabs, steps to the nearest gap on the bridge, places two slabs to restore passability, then returns to the observer line.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan sprints to the shared chest, opens it, takes stone slabs and fences, runs to the gap, places slabs to repair the walkway, places a fence to restore the rail, adds one extra fence at the edge as a barrier, moves between Morgan and the repaired gap to block further breaking, places a marker line of blocks along the bridge midpoint, runs to the signal lamp and toggles it once, then returns to reinforce the repaired section with an additional fence.

target_reaction: Riley turns away from Morgan, backs three blocks toward the observer line, shifts to stand near x=-6,z=-1, looks toward the unclaimed section by the observer line, and begins placing stone slabs on the outer edge there without approaching the contested gap.
